{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_valid_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Count how many rows were excluded due to -999
excluded_count = len(df) - len(df_valid_baseline)
print(f'Number of rows excluded due to biomarker_baseline = -999: {excluded_count}')

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_valid_baseline.loc[df_valid_baseline.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count final number of unique patients after deduplication
final_patient_count = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {final_patient_count}')

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}')"}
